build_biknn_radius_graph: build a biknn radius graph for a batch of atomic systems using the biknn_radius_graph function with PBC support
build_radius_graph_chunked: build a chunked radius graph for a single atomic system to reduce peak memory during distance computation
compute_soft_ranks_single_segment: compute soft ranks for a single padded segment of distances using the compute_soft_ranks_single_segment function
run_batched_radius_graph: run the batched radius graph construction for multiple atomic systems with configurable soft or hard KNN ranking
refactor_segment_argsort_vectorized: refactor the segment_argsort_vectorized function to compute per-segment argsort ranks using a cumsum trick instead of a Python loop
